release_title: Introducing Muse Glimmer: An Open Agentic Model That Runs on Your Device

models.name: Muse Glimmer 30B
models.variant: ~29.6B dense causal transformer + ~1.8B ViT-G/14 perception encoder; Apache 2.0 open weights; distilled from Muse Spark; runs on 24-32GB consumer hardware

notes: Open-weights release distilling Muse Spark into a 30B on-device agent model. Date 2026-08-10 from the HuggingFace model card publish time (2026-08-10T11:28Z) and the research.meta.ai launch post / Zuckerberg announcement of the same day (assignment's OpenRouter 旁证 said 08-09 — one day earlier, official dates win). All 22 evidence rows verified from the model card's DOM benchmark table (tier A: vendor-authored official model card); comparisons vs Gemma4-31B Thinking and Qwen3.6-27B Thinking stay in row notes. 2026-09-01 audit update: the chem/bio preparedness table (MBCT 41.5, HPCT 52.3, VCT 37.0, WMDP Bio 86.5, WMDP Chem 75.2, Lab Bench ProtocolQA 80.2) was converted into 6 evidence rows; the Security/Privacy dual-metric rows (CI Memories violation+coverage, Siren AgentDojo ASR+utility) stay notes-only because they are non-scalar. primary_sources reordered 2026-09-01: the dated research.meta.ai announcement post (published_time 2026-08-10, title matches) is now [0], HF model card [1] — all 28 evidence rows still cite the card, where the tables live. Recommended sampling (temp 1.0 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 64) and High reasoning column recorded as protocol on every row; quantization degradation table (0.2%/1.0% across 15 benchmarks) and DFlash speculative-decoding speeds (RTX 5090 74.9→233.4 tok/s, 3.1x) are deployment facts, not benchmark rows. AA-suffixed rows (GPQA/HLE/AA-LCR) are third-party-run lanes published on the card. Muse Spark 1.2 open-weights was promised 'in coming weeks' at this date — separate release when it lands.
